claims: Millennials are also known as Generation Y.
Millennials fall between Generation X and Generation Z.
As of 2026, Millennials are roughly 30 to 45 years old.
Millennials represent approximately 36% of the U.S. labor force.
Millennials make up the largest share of the U.S. workforce.
Millennials are the first generation to come of age in the internet explosion.
Millennials are often children of Baby Boomers.
Millennials are now raising Generation Alpha.
Millennials are often termed Echo Boomers.
Many Millennials faced the Great Recession early in their careers.
Many Millennials experienced the boomerang effect of moving back in with parents.
ScienceDirect.com and BBVA say Millennials prefer spending on experiences over material goods.
ScienceDirect.com and BBVA say Millennials prioritize sustainability
